VERSION 3.27.x.x
AFFECT /qml/device/view/settings/Settings.qml
    IMPORT org.xovi.Manager 1.0
    TRAVERSE DeviceKeyboardNavigationHandler#settings
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            Loader {
                id: xoviManagerLoader
                anchors.fill: parent
                z: 1000
                active: false
                source: "qrc:/xovi/manager/Manager.qml"
                Component.onCompleted: ManagerNavigation.registerSettingsHost(xoviManagerLoader)
                property string ownerId: "xovi-extension-manager"
                property string pageId: "inventory"
                property string entryPoint: "settings"
                property var directPage: null
                function present() {
                    item.systemNavigator = settings.windowNavigator
                    item.initialOwner = ownerId
                    item.entryPoint = entryPoint
                    item.refresh()
                    if (directPage) item.showPage(directPage)
                    else item.openEntry(ownerId, pageId)
                }
                function openEntry(owner, page, source) {
                    directPage = null
                    ownerId = owner
                    pageId = page
                    entryPoint = source
                    if (item) present()
                    else active = true
                }
                function openPage(page) {
                    directPage = page
                    ownerId = page.id
                    entryPoint = "direct"
                    if (item) present()
                    else active = true
                }
                onLoaded: present()
            }
            Connections {
                target: ManagerNavigation
                function onOpenRequested(owner, page, source) {
                    if (settings.visible) xoviManagerLoader.openEntry(owner, page, source)
                }
                function onPageOpenRequested(page) {
                    if (settings.visible) xoviManagerLoader.openPage(page)
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
    TRAVERSE DeviceKeyboardNavigationHandler#settings > Item#settingsSidebar > ColumnLayout#settingsColumn
        LOCATE BEFORE Repeater#settingsRepeater
        INSERT {
            ArkControls.SidebarItem {
                objectName: "xoviExtensionsEntry"
                text: settings.showLabels ? qsTr("Extensions") : ""
                iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/puzzle"
                type: ArkTokens.Sidebar.primary
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                visible: { ManagerNavigation.launcherRevision; return ManagerNavigation.launcherEntryEnabled("xovi-extension-manager", "inventory", "settings", true) }
                onTriggered: xoviManagerLoader.openEntry("xovi-extension-manager", "inventory", "settings")
            }
            Loader {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                Layout.preferredHeight: item ? item.implicitHeight : 0
                visible: !!item && item.count > 0
                source: "qrc:/xovi/manager/LauncherEntries.qml"
                onLoaded: {
                    item.location = "settings"
                    item.excludedPages = ["xovi-extension-manager/inventory"]
                    item.showLabels = Qt.binding(function() { return settings.showLabels })
                    item.refresh()
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
AFFECT /qml/device/view/main/MainView.qml
    IMPORT org.xovi.Manager 1.0
    TRAVERSE Background#root > FocusScope#rootItem
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            Loader {
                anchors.fill: parent
                z: 2100
                source: "qrc:/xovi/manager/NotificationAgent.qml"
                onLoaded: item.nativeQueue = Qt.binding(function() { return root.notificationQueue })
            }
            Loader {
                id: xoviPinnedManager
                Component.onCompleted: ManagerNavigation.registerLauncher(xoviPinnedManager)
                anchors.fill: parent
                z: 2000
                active: false
                property string ownerId: ""
                property string pageId: ""
                property string entryPoint: "shortcut"
                property var directPage: null
                source: "qrc:/xovi/manager/Manager.qml"
                onLoaded: {
                    item.systemNavigator = root.windowNavigator
                    item.initialOwner = ownerId
                    item.entryPoint = entryPoint
                    item.refresh()
                    if (directPage) item.showPage(directPage)
                    else item.openEntry(ownerId, pageId)
                }
            }
            Connections {
                target: ManagerNavigation
                function onPageOpenRequested(page) {
                    if (ManagerNavigation.settingsHostVisible()) return
                    xoviPinnedManager.directPage = page
                    xoviPinnedManager.ownerId = page.id
                    xoviPinnedManager.entryPoint = "direct"
                    if (xoviPinnedManager.item) {
                        xoviPinnedManager.item.initialOwner = page.id
                        xoviPinnedManager.item.entryPoint = "direct"
                        xoviPinnedManager.item.showPage(page)
                    } else xoviPinnedManager.active = true
                }
                function onOpenRequested(owner, pageId, source) {
                    if (ManagerNavigation.settingsHostVisible()) return
                    xoviPinnedManager.directPage = null
                    xoviPinnedManager.ownerId = owner
                    xoviPinnedManager.pageId = pageId
                    xoviPinnedManager.entryPoint = source
                    if (xoviPinnedManager.item) {
                        xoviPinnedManager.item.initialOwner = owner
                        xoviPinnedManager.item.entryPoint = source
                        xoviPinnedManager.item.refresh()
                        xoviPinnedManager.item.openEntry(owner, pageId)
                    } else xoviPinnedManager.active = true
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/Sidebar.qml
    IMPORT org.xovi.Manager 1.0
    TRAVERSE DeviceKeyboardNavigationHandler#root > ColumnLayout#filterColumn
        LOCATE AFTER DeviceKeyboardNavigationHandler#integrationsHandler
        INSERT {
            Loader {
                id: xoviSidebarEntries
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                Layout.preferredHeight: item ? item.implicitHeight : 0
                visible: !!item && item.count > 0
                source: "qrc:/xovi/manager/LauncherEntries.qml"
                onLoaded: item.activated.connect(function() { root.hide() })
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
    TRAVERSE DeviceKeyboardNavigationHandler#root > ColumnLayout#filterColumn > SidebarFilterItem#filterMyFiles
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            visible: { ManagerNavigation.launcherRevision; return ManagerNavigation.nativeEntryEnabled("my-files", "sidebar") }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
    TRAVERSE DeviceKeyboardNavigationHandler#root > ColumnLayout#filterColumn > SidebarFilterItem#filterPinned
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {

        }
    END TRAVERSE
    TRAVERSE DeviceKeyboardNavigationHandler#root > ColumnLayout#filterColumn > SidebarFilterItem#filterTags
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            visible: { ManagerNavigation.launcherRevision; return ManagerNavigation.nativeEntryEnabled("tags", "sidebar") }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
    TRAVERSE DeviceKeyboardNavigationHandler#root > ColumnLayout#filterColumn > SidebarFilterItem#filterTrashed
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            visible: { ManagerNavigation.launcherRevision; return ManagerNavigation.nativeEntryEnabled("trash", "sidebar") }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
    TRAVERSE DeviceKeyboardNavigationHandler#root > ColumnLayout#filterColumn > IconButton#quickHelp
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            visible: { ManagerNavigation.launcherRevision; return ManagerNavigation.nativeEntryEnabled("help", "sidebar") }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
    TRAVERSE DeviceKeyboardNavigationHandler#root > ColumnLayout#filterColumn > IconButton#settingsButton
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            visible: { ManagerNavigation.launcherRevision; return ManagerNavigation.nativeEntryEnabled("settings", "sidebar") }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
    TRAVERSE DeviceKeyboardNavigationHandler#root > ColumnLayout#filterColumn > DeviceKeyboardNavigationHandler#filterHandler
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            visible: { ManagerNavigation.launcherRevision; return ManagerNavigation.nativeEntryEnabled("filters", "sidebar") }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
    TRAVERSE DeviceKeyboardNavigationHandler#root > ColumnLayout#filterColumn > DeviceKeyboardNavigationHandler#integrationsHandler
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            visible: { ManagerNavigation.launcherRevision; return ManagerNavigation.nativeEntryEnabled("integrations", "sidebar") }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/homescreen/qml/CreateMenu.qml
    IMPORT org.xovi.Manager 1.0
    TRAVERSE Item#root > Rectangle#primaryContainer > RowLayout#primaryLayout
        LOCATE AFTER Repeater
        INSERT {
            Loader {
                id: xoviBottomEntries
                Layout.preferredWidth: item ? item.implicitWidth : 0
                Layout.preferredHeight: 80
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignVCenter
                visible: !!item && item.count > 0
                Component.onCompleted: setSource("qrc:/xovi/manager/LauncherEntries.qml", {
                    "location": "bottom",
                    "popupOverlay": Qt.binding(function() { return root.popupOverlay }),
                    "anchorTarget": root,
                    "currentView": Qt.binding(function() { return root.view }),
                    "slots": Qt.binding(function() { return Math.max(1, Math.min(3, Math.floor(((root.parent ? root.parent.width : root.width) - 480) / 104))) })
                })
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/homescreen/qml/CreateMenu.qml
    TRAVERSE Item#root > Rectangle#primaryContainer > RowLayout#primaryLayout > Repeater > WidgetLoader#widgetLoader
        REPLACE visible WITH {
            visible: {
                ManagerNavigation.launcherRevision
                return !!item?.supportedViews.includes(root.view)
                    && ManagerNavigation.nativeEntryEnabled(item.objectName, "bottom")
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/modules/settings/qml/QuickSettingsWindow.qml
    IMPORT org.xovi.Manager 1.0
    TRAVERSE BaseView#root > Item > Background
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            id: xoviQuickSettingsPanel
        }
    END TRAVERSE
    TRAVERSE BaseView#root > Item
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            Connections {
                target: ManagerNavigation
                function onQuickNotificationsRequested() {
                    xoviNotificationDrawer.active = !xoviNotificationDrawer.active
                }
                function onOpenRequested(owner, pageId, source) {
                    if (source === "quick") root.windowNavigator.close("settings/window/quicksettings")
                }
                function onPageOpenRequested(page) {
                    if (root.visible) root.windowNavigator.close("settings/window/quicksettings")
                }
            }
            Loader {
                id: xoviNotificationDrawer
                anchors.left: parent.left
                anchors.right: xoviQuickSettingsPanel.left
                anchors.top: parent.top
                anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                z: 100
                active: false
                source: "qrc:/xovi/manager/NotificationDrawer.qml"
                onLoaded: {
                    item.closeRequested.connect(function() { xoviNotificationDrawer.active = false })
                    item.openPage.connect(function(owner, pageId) {
                        ManagerNavigation.openSettings(owner, pageId, "notification")
                        root.windowNavigator.close()
                    })
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/modules/settings/qml/quicksettings/ToggleColumn.qml
    IMPORT org.xovi.Manager 1.0
    TRAVERSE ColumnLayout#root
        LOCATE AFTER Repeater
        INSERT {
            ArkControls.StateSwitch {
                objectName: "xoviQuickNotifications"
                visible: { ManagerNavigation.launcherRevision; return ManagerNavigation.launcherEntryEnabled("xovi-extension-manager", "notifications", "quick", true) }
                iconSource: "qrc:/xovi/manager/icons/bell.svg"
                onClicked: ManagerNavigation.toggleQuickNotifications()
            }
            Loader {
                Layout.preferredHeight: item ? item.implicitHeight : 0
                visible: !!item && item.count > 0
                source: "qrc:/xovi/manager/LauncherEntries.qml"
                onLoaded: {
                    item.location = "quick"
                    item.excludedPages = ["xovi-extension-manager/notifications"]
                    item.refresh()
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/modules/settings/qml/quicksettings/ToggleColumn.qml
    TRAVERSE ColumnLayout#root > Repeater > WidgetLoader
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT { visible: !item || item.xoviShortcutEnabled !== false }

END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/settings/LanguageAndKeyboard.qml
    IMPORT org.xovi.Manager 1.0
    TRAVERSE DeviceKeyboardNavigationHandler#root
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            QtObject {
                property string nativeLanguage: root.languageSettings ? root.languageSettings.languageCode : ""
                onNativeLanguageChanged: ManagerNavigation.setNativeLanguage(nativeLanguage)
                Component.onCompleted: ManagerNavigation.setNativeLanguage(nativeLanguage)
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
